description: List associations officially recognized as utilite publique (RUP) by French state decree. Currently 1,966 RUP fiches (as of 2026-10-19). RUP status grants major fiscal benefits to donors (75% tax deduction vs 66% standard) and is a strong signal of institutional credibility. Recommended for institutional grounding -- mecenat, defiscalisation, public-private partnerships, B2B research.
name: get_recognized_associations
